name: Proposed Russia employment, wage and banking terms for a DPRK IT-worker deployment

attribution.legal_posture: The source describes a reported proposal or contract. Performance, payment, account opening, Russian enforcement, and knowing host-company participation are outside the source; the source supplies no adjudication.

infrastructure.statement: MSMT reports a proposed ten-year arrangement beginning in early 2025 for 25 DPRK IT workers. The reported terms included an average monthly salary of at least $1,200, overtime and holiday pay of $4 per hour, and Russian bank accounts to be opened for the workers.
infrastructure.timeframe: Proposed ten-year arrangement beginning in early 2025
infrastructure.evidence_class: official multilateral report based on participating-state information
